title: QuestBench: Can LLMs ask the right question to acquire information in reasoning tasks?
authors_zh: Belinda Z. Li, Been Kim, Zi Wang
paper_type_zh: 可验证的主动信息获取推理基准
best_for_zh: 研究澄清提问、主动推理或信息获取策略的研究者。
one_line: QuestBench turns clarification into a solver-checked choice: select the single missing variable whose answer makes an underspecified reasoning problem uniquely solvable.
QuestBench 将澄清提问变为可由求解器验证的选择：找出唯一能消除题目剩余解歧义的缺失变量。
why: It separates asking for necessary information from solving an already complete task.
inclusion_reason: QuestBench supplies solver-verified clarification-choice records whose label is whether a question makes an underspecified reasoning task uniquely solvable.

title: Problem
问题
html: Most reasoning benchmarks assume complete information, whereas real user queries often omit one crucial variable. A model that guesses directly can fail even when it knows how to solve the complete problem. QuestBench formalizes information acquisition as a constraint-satisfaction problem with missing assignments and asks models to select the minimal sufficient clarification question. It covers logic, PDDL planning, human-edited GSM, and equation-based GSM tasks, testing whether models know what information is missing rather than only solving fully specified problems.
大多数推理基准默认题目信息完整，但真实用户问题经常缺少一个关键变量；模型如果直接猜答案，即使具备求解能力也会失败。QuestBench 将信息获取形式化为缺失变量的约束满足问题，要求模型从候选中选择“最少且足够”的澄清问题。它覆盖逻辑、PDDL 规划、人工改写 GSM 和方程化 GSM 四类任务，评估模型是否知道自己缺什么，而非只会在完整条件下求解。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The core contribution is four one-question subsets: Logic-Q hides one proposition, Planning-Q hides part of the initial state, GSM-Q manually removes a key number, and GSME-Q first translates problems into equations before hiding a variable. Each record contains an underspecified problem, candidate clarification questions, hidden state, and correct option. A program checks whether asking a variable is sufficient to uniquely determine the answer and controls difficulty through variable count, ambiguity, and reasoning depth. The feedback contract is whether the question removes all remaining solution ambiguity.
核心贡献是四个 one-question 子集：Logic-Q 缺一个命题，Planning-Q 隐藏部分初始状态，GSM-Q 由人工删除关键数值，GSME-Q 则先转成方程再隐藏变量。每条记录包含不完整题目、候选澄清问题、隐藏状态和正确选项；程序根据完整 CSP 检查某问题是否足以唯一确定答案，并可按变量数量、候选歧义和推理深度控制难度。反馈合同是“所问变量能否消除所有剩余解歧义”。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Formalize complete tasks: Convert logic, planning, and mathematics problems into CSPs with variables and constraints.
  1. Hide one assignment: Remove a key variable so the answer is no longer unique, while retaining the full state as oracle.
  1. Generate question options: List askable variables and use a solver to determine which questions restore a unique answer after receiving their values.
  1. Evaluate selection: The model chooses a clarification question or “not sure,” and accuracy is computed against correct options. Reproduction must fix option ordering, CSP solvers, human-edited GSM versions, and random seeds.

1. 形式化完整任务： 将逻辑、规划和数学题转换为带变量与约束的 CSP。
  1. 隐藏一个赋值： 删除使答案不再唯一的关键变量，同时保留完整状态作为 oracle。
  1. 生成候选问题： 列出可询问变量，并用求解器检查哪些问题在获得答案后足以恢复唯一解。
  1. 评测选择： 模型从候选中选择澄清问题或 not sure，按正确选项准确率评分。复现需固定候选顺序、CSP solver、人工 GSM 修改版本和随机种子。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Frontier models perform strongly on GSM-Q and GSME-Q but usually reach only about 40–50% accuracy on Logic-Q and Planning-Q. Analysis shows that some models can solve the fully specified version yet still fail to identify which variable to ask about. In Planning-Q, models remain overconfident even when “not sure” is available. This controlled comparison supports the distinction between solving and information acquisition, although multiple-choice selection is narrower than real free-form questioning.
前沿模型在 GSM-Q 与 GSME-Q 上表现较强，但在 Logic-Q 和 Planning-Q 上通常只有约 40%–50% 准确率。进一步分析发现，一些模型能够解决信息完整版本，却仍无法识别应该询问哪个变量；在 Planning-Q 中，即使提供 not sure 选项，模型也倾向过度自信。该受控对照支持“求解能力不等于信息获取能力”，但多选设置比真实自由提问更受限。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier clarification-question evaluations rely on human dialogue or subjective open-ended judgment, making necessity hard to verify. QuestBench uses missing-assignment CSPs to define provable minimal information requirements and compares complete and incomplete versions of the same underlying task. It changes the input contract: the model must choose information before solving rather than assuming all conditions are visible.
此前“澄清问题”评测多依赖人工对话或开放式主观判断，难以自动确定某个问题是否真正必要。QuestBench 的新意是用缺失赋值 CSP 给出可证明的最小信息需求，并将完全相同的底层题目用于完整/不完整对照。改变的是推理任务的输入契约：模型先选择信息，再求解，而不是默认所有条件可见。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. One-question limit: The benchmark allows at most one clarification and does not cover multi-turn active exploration or question-cost tradeoffs.
  1. Option bias: Multiple-choice options reduce natural-language generation difficulty and may expose superficial patterns.
  1. Formalization scope: Tasks must be expressible as deterministic CSPs; ambiguous preferences, noisy replies, and user refusal are not covered. Extensions need free-form question parsing and interaction costs.

1. 一问限制： benchmark 只研究最多一个澄清问题，无法覆盖多轮主动探索和问题成本权衡。
  1. 候选式偏差： 多选选项降低了自然语言生成难度，也可能让模型利用表面模式。
  1. 形式化范围： 任务必须能表示为确定 CSP；现实需求中的含糊偏好、噪声回答和用户拒答尚未覆盖。扩展时应加入自由问题解析与交互成本。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluate active reasoning: Compare performance on complete problems, underspecified problems, and clarification selection to identify models that can solve but cannot ask.
  1. Train information-acquisition policies: Use correct questions as SFT labels or reward recovery of a unique CSP solution.
  1. Build domain data: Hide one key field in formalizable business rules and generate candidate questions. For multi-turn retrieval or unreliable user answers, QuestBench should be treated as a minimal one-step baseline, not a complete agent evaluation.

1. 评测主动推理： 比较模型在完整题、缺失题和澄清选择上的表现，定位“会解但不会问”。
  1. 训练信息获取策略： 将正确问题作为 SFT 标签，或用 CSP 唯一解恢复作为 RL 奖励。
  1. 构造领域数据： 对可形式化业务规则隐藏一个关键字段并生成候选问题。若任务需多轮检索或用户答案不可靠，应把 QuestBench 作为最小单步基线，而非完整 agent 评测。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: QuestBench tests whether a model can ask the minimal sufficient question when one variable is missing.
  2. Method takeaway: Complete CSP states, key-assignment hiding, question options, and unique-solution verification.
  3. Data takeaway: Logic-Q, Planning-Q, GSM-Q, and GSME-Q retain complete and incomplete versions.
  4. Evidence anchor: Logic-Q and Planning-Q are around 40–50%, and models often ask incorrectly despite solving complete versions.
  5. Reuse decision: It fits active information acquisition; multi-turn settings need a separate interaction environment.

1. 一句话定位： QuestBench 测试模型能否在缺一个变量时提出最小充分问题。
  2. 方法抓手： CSP 完整状态、关键赋值隐藏、候选问题和唯一解验证。
  3. 数据抓手： Logic-Q、Planning-Q、GSM-Q、GSME-Q 均保留完整与不完整版本。
  4. 证据锚点： Logic-Q/Planning-Q 约 40%–50%，且模型常在会解完整题时仍问错。
  5. 复用决定： 适合主动信息获取；多轮场景需另加交互环境。
